method: Fresh independent reopened source measurement. Per-component directed topology, transformed bounds, both-direction strict-interior 3-ray majority contact per child island. Every actual triangle centroid tested against the full scene for outward line-of-sight. Mouth center checked from actual terminal-ring vertices and lumen probed at center and four off-axis points. Numerical ray offsets are self-hit handling, not anatomical size gates. No percentage acceptance gate.
